threat_event: Payroll handoff data for up to 2.4 million workers is copied from the WCP export bucket
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: The division's customer information sits in an affiliate's bucket with provider-managed keys and no read logging
treatment_plan: Move intake into the payroll engine accounts with division-held keys (POAM-006, POAM-020)

threat_event: Malicious script on a hosted checkout page skims card data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Script inventory incomplete for 2 of 5 pages; tamper detection not on all pages
existing_controls: Content security policy; quarterly page review
treatment_plan: Complete script inventory and authorization; tamper detection on all pages (POAM-023)

threat_event: A segmentation failure exposes the CDE and goes unnoticed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Six-monthly segmentation test missed in 2026 H1 after a network change
treatment_plan: Run the test; tie network changes to a scope review (POAM-021)

threat_event: Tokenization vault keys are compromised
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Key custodians hold split components
existing_controls: Split knowledge and dual control; hardware-backed keys
treatment_plan: Keep; annual key ceremony audit

threat_event: ACH origination misses sponsor bank A's cutoff and workers are paid late
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single origination path to sponsor bank A
regulatory_driver: Sponsor bank A contract; state wage payment laws (generic)
treatment_plan: Secondary transmission method agreed with the bank

threat_event: Fraudsters change workers' direct deposit accounts and divert pay
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Changes enter through the WCP self-service app
existing_controls: Payroll anomaly model; first-pay holds for high-risk changes
treatment_plan: Second-channel notice; shared fraud signals with the Cloud Software division

threat_event: A payroll tax deposit is missed and penalties fall on the division
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Deposit schedules vary by agency
treatment_plan: Keep; quarterly reconciliation review

threat_event: The FTC Safeguards notice or the sponsor banks' 24-hour notice is missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: The group matrix does not include either (gap 7)
treatment_plan: Add both to the group matrix; exercise in the tabletop (POAM-004)
owner: Payments and Payroll chief compliance officer

threat_event: Sponsor bank A suspends or ends the payroll program
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One sponsor bank for payroll
treatment_plan: Negotiate a contingency sponsor bank

threat_event: State regulators conclude the payroll funds flow needs money transmitter licenses
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Licensing analysis incomplete
existing_controls: Funds only in sponsor bank FBO accounts
treatment_plan: Complete the analysis by 2027-03-31
owner: Payments and Payroll chief compliance officer

threat_event: The division cannot show it oversees the WCP as a service provider for its customer information
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No intercompany agreement; risk assessment omits the flow
treatment_plan: Intercompany agreement; add the WCP to the division risk assessment and oversight (POAM-020, POAM-022)

threat_event: Ransomware hits the payroll engine during a pay run
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared identity and CI/CD with other divisions
treatment_plan: Quarterly restore of the payroll engine to an isolated account

threat_event: A fraudulent merchant passes onboarding and runs up chargebacks
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Onboarding relies on automated identity checks
treatment_plan: Manual review for high-risk categories

threat_event: The payroll anomaly model holds legitimate payrolls and workers are paid late
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Model thresholds tuned for fraud catch rate
existing_controls: Human review of every hold within 2 hours
treatment_plan: Monitor false-positive holds by employer size and region (P10)

threat_event: A payroll operations insider changes bank details to divert pay
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Operations staff can edit worker bank details for corrections
existing_controls: Dual approval for bank detail edits; activity monitoring
treatment_plan: Keep; monthly review of edits

threat_event: A calculation error after a release pays workers the wrong amount
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Tax tables change often
regulatory_driver: Service agreements with employers; SOC 1 commitments
treatment_plan: Keep; add processing integrity criteria to SOC 2 scope (P09)

threat_event: Payroll reports with customer information are emailed to employers without encryption
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Some employers ask for emailed reports
treatment_plan: Disable emailed reports with sensitive fields

threat_event: The Qualified Individual's annual board report misses affiliate flows and material risks
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2025 report did not mention the WCP handoff
existing_controls: Annual written report to the division board
treatment_plan: Include affiliate flows and P07 results in the 2026 report

threat_event: The payroll continuity plan fails because it assumes the WCP is available
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Plan written without the handoff dependency
treatment_plan: Joint continuity plan and test with the Cloud Software division (POAM-024)

threat_event: A tax filing network outage delays filings
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: External networks
treatment_plan: Keep
